title: Boredom · noun
subtitle: 「無聊／乏味／百無聊賴／單調」，究竟是哪一種 boredom？
description: 「無聊／乏味／百無聊賴／單調」，究竟是哪一種 boredom？

words.meaning: 乏味；冗長單調帶來的厭倦
words.note: 使用者提供。tedium 是 boredom 最核心的正式近義詞之一，特別強調事情因冗長、重複、單調而令人厭倦。它比一般 boredom 更常把焦點放在活動本身的單調性。
words.example: The long wait was made worse by the tedium of having nothing to do.

exercises.original: The boredom of entering the same data for hours made the task exhausting.
exercises.zh: 連續數小時輸入相同數據的乏味令人疲憊。
exercises.upgrade: tedium · 乏味；冗長單調帶來的厭倦

options.explanation: the same data for hours makes repetitive monotony the decisive clue.
直接表示對主題或活動沒有興趣、投入不足。 本題的決定性線索是 boredom produced by repetitive work；這裡需要的是「重複／冗長造成的乏味」。因此 lack of interest 雖與 boredom 相鄰，但究竟是主觀無聊、內容無趣、重複單調、深層倦怠、低能量狀態或一般冷漠並不最吻合。
較文學、正式，表示長期缺乏刺激或意義造成的深層倦怠無聊。 本題的決定性線索是 boredom produced by repetitive work；這裡需要的是「重複／冗長造成的乏味」。因此 ennui 雖與 boredom 相鄰，但究竟是主觀無聊、內容無趣、重複單調、深層倦怠、低能量狀態或一般冷漠並不最吻合。
強調重複、千篇一律和缺乏變化；嚴格說更偏 boredom 的成因／特質。 本題的決定性線索是 boredom produced by repetitive work；這裡需要的是「重複／冗長造成的乏味」。因此 monotony 雖與 boredom 相鄰，但究竟是主觀無聊、內容無趣、重複單調、深層倦怠、低能量狀態或一般冷漠並不最吻合。
強調無精打采、缺乏精力與動機，常是 boredom 的外在表現。 本題的決定性線索是 boredom produced by repetitive work；這裡需要的是「重複／冗長造成的乏味」。因此 listlessness 雖與 boredom 相鄰，但究竟是主觀無聊、內容無趣、重複單調、深層倦怠、低能量狀態或一般冷漠並不最吻合。
表示冷漠、缺乏關心或動機，通常比 boredom 更廣、更嚴重，未必因無聊而起。 本題的決定性線索是 boredom produced by repetitive work；這裡需要的是「重複／冗長造成的乏味」。因此 apathy 雖與 boredom 相鄰，但究竟是主觀無聊、內容無趣、重複單調、深層倦怠、低能量狀態或一般冷漠並不最吻合。

exercises.original: She struggled with the boredom of a six-hour delay at the airport.
exercises.zh: 她很難忍受機場六小時延誤帶來的乏味。
exercises.upgrade: tedium · 乏味；冗長單調帶來的厭倦

words.note: 使用者提供。lack of interest 是透明、通用的改寫，強調對某主題、活動或內容沒有興趣。它比 tedium 少一點『活動本身冗長單調』，更直接描述個人的 engagement 不足。
words.example: His lack of interest in the lecture was obvious from the way he kept looking at his phone.

exercises.original: Her boredom with the subject became obvious when she stopped asking questions.
exercises.zh: 她不再提問後，對該科缺乏興趣變得很明顯。
exercises.upgrade: lack of interest · 缺乏興趣；提不起興趣

options.explanation: stopping questions shows disengagement from the subject rather than repetition or fatigue.

exercises.zh: 他對辦公室政治缺乏興趣，所以很少參與那些對話。

words.meaning: 百無聊賴；倦怠無聊；精神上的厭倦
words.note: ennui 是較正式、文學性的詞，表示因長期缺乏刺激、意義或新鮮感而產生的深層無聊與倦怠。它比普通 boredom 更持久、更帶 existential / languid flavour。
words.example: A sense of ennui settled over him during the long, uneventful summer.

exercises.original: After months with no new projects or challenges, she felt a deep boredom that was hard to shake.
exercises.zh: 數月沒有新項目或挑戰後，她感到一種難以擺脫的深層倦怠無聊。
exercises.upgrade: ennui · 百無聊賴；倦怠無聊；精神上的厭倦

options.explanation: months, no new projects or challenges, and hard to shake indicate prolonged, deep boredom.

exercises.original: The novel captures the boredom of a wealthy character who has everything but feels no purpose.
exercises.zh: 小說描寫一名甚麼都有卻找不到人生目的的富有人物的百無聊賴。
exercises.upgrade: ennui · 百無聊賴；倦怠無聊；精神上的厭倦

options.explanation: wealth plus lack of purpose gives the literary, existential flavour of ennui.

words.meaning: 單調；千篇一律；重複乏味

words.example: The monotony of doing the same route every day eventually became exhausting.

exercises.original: The boredom of following exactly the same routine every day began to affect morale.
exercises.zh: 每天完全重複同一套日常的單調開始影響士氣。

exercises.original: She left the job because of the boredom of performing one identical task all shift.
exercises.zh: 她因整個班次都做同一項工作太單調而離職。

words.example: The long afternoon of waiting left everyone in a state of listlessness.

exercises.original: The children's boredom after hours indoors turned into lying around and doing nothing.
exercises.zh: 孩子在室內待了數小時後，無聊變成了無精打采地躺著甚麼也不做。

exercises.original: By late afternoon, boredom had left the waiting passengers too unmotivated even to talk.
exercises.zh: 到下午較晚時，無聊令等候乘客連聊天的興致都沒有。
exercises.upgrade: listlessness · 無精打采；懶散倦怠；因無聊而提不起勁

exercises.original: The boredom of the long break showed in his sluggish movements and lack of enthusiasm.
exercises.zh: 漫長休息期的無聊反映在他遲緩的動作和缺乏熱情上。
exercises.upgrade: listlessness · 無精打采；懶散倦怠；因無聊而提不起勁

falseSynonyms.zh: tedium 更強調冗長、重複、單調的活動本身所造成的厭倦；boredom 更一般。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The tedium of data entry was exhausting. I felt boredom during the wait.

falseSynonyms.zh: lack of interest 只表示不感興趣；boredom 還可能包含不耐煩、需要刺激或時間難熬。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON His lack of interest in politics was obvious. The long delay caused boredom.

falseSynonyms.zh: ennui 更持久、更文學、更像深層倦怠；短暫無聊一般不用 ennui。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Months of inactivity produced ennui. Ten minutes of waiting caused boredom.

falseSynonyms.zh: monotony 嚴格說是單調／重複本身，常是 boredom 的成因，而不是完全相同的主觀情緒。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The monotony of the routine was exhausting. The routine caused boredom.

falseSynonyms.zh: listlessness 是無精打采、沒動力；它可以由 boredom 引起，但也可由疲倦或身體不適造成。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The children became listless after hours indoors. The repetitive lesson caused boredom.

falseSynonyms.zh: apathy 是冷漠、缺乏關心或動機，通常更廣、更嚴重；人可能因不在乎而 apathetic，並非只是覺得無聊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Public apathy reduced turnout. The lecture produced boredom.

falseSynonyms.zh: restlessness 是坐立不安、想活動或改變；它可以是 boredom 的結果，但不是同一情緒。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The long wait caused restlessness. The dull task caused boredom.

falseSynonyms.zh: dullness 通常描述某件事無趣、沉悶的特質；boredom 描述人的感受。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The dullness of the lecture was obvious. The students felt boredom.
